segments.topic: Mike Tyson's early rise under Cus D'Amato
segments.source_text: Mike Tyson's career was launched with help from trainer Cus D'Amato. Before working with Tyson, D'Amato had guided Floyd Patterson to a world heavyweight title.

segments.topic: Trevor Berbick's fight with Mike Tyson in 1986
segments.source_text: On November 22, 1986, twenty-year-old Mike Tyson defeated Trevor Berbick by second-round technical knockout. Tyson won the WBC heavyweight title and became the youngest world heavyweight champion.

segments.topic: James "Buster" Douglas ends Tyson's unbeaten run in Tokyo
segments.source_text: On February 11, 1990, James "Buster" Douglas knocked Mike Tyson out in the tenth round in Tokyo. The result ended Tyson's unbeaten professional run.

segments.topic: Evander Holyfield defeats Mike Tyson in their 1996 title fight
segments.source_text: In their November 1996 heavyweight title fight, Evander Holyfield defeated Mike Tyson by eleventh-round technical knockout.

segments.topic: Mike Tyson's 1997 rematch with Evander Holyfield
segments.source_text: In their June 28, 1997 rematch, Mike Tyson was disqualified in the third round after biting Evander Holyfield.
